$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, D-C-SIZEOF-OF-A-COMPOUND-LITERAL-IS-A-PARSE-ERROR): `sizeof (int){ 7 }` is `sizeof` applied to the unary-expression `(int){ 7 }` — a compound literal, a postfix-expression (C 6.5.2.5) — not the `sizeof ( type-name )` form. DSS refused every such program at PARSE (P_UnexpectedToken: the type form closed at `)` and left the brace list over). The grammar now says so itself: `sizeofType` and `alignofType` declare `notFollowedBy: [BlockOpen]`, a PEG not-predicate the parser applies to a cleanly-closed speculative probe. The exit code is a bitmask of the shapes measured wrong (1 a scalar literal, 2 a structure literal, 4 an unsized array literal's own length, 8 `[0]` and `.d` postfixes, 16 an array bound and a static initializer, 32 UNEVALUATED — the initializer's `n++` never runs, 64 a pointer literal and an arithmetic operand after the operand, 128 `__alignof__` of one where `__GNUC__` is defined, 256 the type form `sizeof (int) + 1` unchanged). MEASURED 2026-09-30 through `dssharness run probe-reference-cc`, this file: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 at -std=c17 -pedantic-errors and -std=c2x (run 20261001-022049-32581ab2), MSVC 19.51 at /std:clatest and /std:c17 (run 20261001-022057-caa99172) and mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 in both modes (run 20261001-022026-6c2b0752) all exit 42. Every operand comes from argc where a value is read. The release arm is REPORT-ONLY: the sizes are constants either way; its value is that the optimized pipeline keeps the unevaluated operand unevaluated.
